## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Manual vs automatic
```{r arima-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=16}
library(fpp3)
spain <- global_economy |> filter(Country == "Spain")
train <- spain |> filter(Year <= 2010)
fit <- train |>
  model(
    drift = RW(log(GDP) ~ drift()),
    auto = ARIMA(log(GDP) ~ PDQ(0,0,0)),
    ar110 = ARIMA(log(GDP) ~ pdq(1,1,0) + PDQ(0,0,0))
  )
glance(fit) |> arrange(AICc)
fit |> forecast(h = 8) |> accuracy(spain) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MASE)
fit |> select(auto) |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("The differencing order", correct = TRUE),
  answer("The seasonal period"),
  answer("The number of Fourier terms"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("No seasonal period for annual data", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Seasonal ARIMA is mandatory for annual series"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),

  trim = TRUE
)
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}

  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
```
